ana: Quick heads-up — seeing a regression on cold nodes for a subset of routes. Token-level tail up ~120ms compared to baseline. Suspect: KV-slot skew + aggressive kernel switch on low-occupancy nodes.

mike: Can you drop the quick numbers/graph?

ana: Short snapshot: queue_wait_ms P50: 8, P95: 42, P99: 160. Batch size hist (recent 5m): size=1 -> 62%, 2-4 -> 25%, >8 -> 13%. KV hit-rate on affected routes: ~12%.

zara: Low KV hit-rate would definitely push small-batch kernel path. Are we seeing slot evictions at cold start?

ana: Profiler trace shows kernel_selector choosing kernel_v2_small when kv_slot_util < 0.2. Handoff churn causes scheduler_lock spikes and kernel swaps. Snippet from node logs:
```
[profile] kernel_choice=kernel_v2_small reason="kv_slot_util<0.2" batch=1
[profile] kernel_swap time_ms=42 kv_evictions=8
```

tay: That smells like a threshold tuned for steady-state, not coldspin. Two quick ideas: delay kernel switch until batch_wait_ms > 15ms OR batch_size_hist.P50 > 2. Also consider a lightweight KV prefill on boot.

pranav: Can we get a flamegraph for the spike? Need to know kv_lookup vs kernel_exec vs scheduler_lock contribution.

ana: Flame summary (5s window at spike): exec=65%, kv_lookup=18%, scheduler_lock=10%. Scheduler_lock correlates with kernel handoff log lines.

mike: Ok—adds to instrumentation wishlist: scheduler_handoff_time / total_exec_time per-node, per-route kv_hit_rate, avg_batch_size, queueing_delay. Those will help triage without jumping into nodes.

zara: I'll mock up dashboard widgets: batch_size histogram (by route), queue_wait P50/P95/P99, kernel_handoff_rate, scheduler_lock_ms. 1m rollups for now.

tay: For immediate mitigation plan: 1) bump kernel-selection holdout to 250ms on nodes with uptime < 2m 2) opportunistic prefix warmup for first N requests 3) schedule a KV-prefill job on node spin (low-priority).

deploy-bot: Rollout started: scheduler-heuristics@canary -> nodes: gpu-canary-5,gpu-canary-6 (1709123550)

ana: Early canary result: P95 for affected routes dropped from ~420ms -> ~310ms. Batch_size P50 on canary rose from 1 -> 3.

pranav: Great. For the instrumentation PRs please include token-level latency buckets: kv_lookup, kernel_queue_wait, kernel_exec, emit. Tag metrics with route and node_id.

mike: Action items: dashboard -> @zara, heuristics PR -> @tay, profiling artifact + writeup -> @ana. :thumbsup:

ana: I'll open a profiling artifact repo link + perf.md with repro steps and attach once ready.

zara: Dashboard PR incoming in ~1h.

tay: Heuristic PR will be WIP today, will post benchmarks.

ana: Thanks all — will follow up with the PR links and canary metrics.
